follow-up time: until death or discharge from the neonatal unit
exposure: persistent pulmonary hypertension of the newborn (PPHN)
cohort: 51 neonates diagnosed with PPHN admitted to the neonatal unit at Mankweng Hospital in South Africa between January 2015 and December 2017
finding: The prevalence of PPHN was 0.76%, with a high mortality rate of 45.1%, and meconium aspiration was the most common risk factor.
